nodes.label: Mailbox per phone queue
nodes.rationale: Strict order within a conversation + parallelism across conversations + fairness; avoids races on history/tree state.

nodes.label: Backpressure (queue.max_pending)
nodes.rationale: Bounded backlog: reject with busy_message instead of queueing without limit.

nodes.label: Graceful drain on SIGTERM
nodes.rationale: Stop intake and finish backlog within drain_timeout_seconds.

nodes.label: At-least-once delivery (Redis)
nodes.rationale: Message leaves its mailbox only after the handler returns; done:<msg_id> marker skips replays.

nodes.label: Orphan requeue of dead replicas
nodes.rationale: Stale worker heartbeat -> another replica moves owned phones back to the ready line.

nodes.label: Horizontal scaling with Redis
nodes.rationale: Shared queue/state lets N chatbot replicas consume the same backlog.

nodes.label: Idempotency by msg_id
nodes.rationale: Meta redelivers webhooks for ~24h; dedup at ingest.

nodes.label: Per-phone rate limiting
nodes.rationale: Fixed window per phone, one notice per window, input truncation.

nodes.label: Conversation state with TTL
nodes.rationale: History + tree session live in a state store and expire after inactivity.

nodes.label: LLM circuit breaker
nodes.rationale: Fail fast with fallback when the LLM is down instead of waiting for every timeout.

nodes.label: Meta send retries (429/5xx)
nodes.rationale: Honour Retry-After; never retry other 4xx.

nodes.label: Fail-closed production config
nodes.rationale: APP_ENV=production refuses to start with missing secrets or placeholders.

nodes.label: Config profiles config.<APP_ENV>.yaml
nodes.rationale: Per-environment/tenant overlay deep-merged over config.yaml.

nodes.label: Host-only ports / minimal public surface
nodes.rationale: Only /webhook and /health public via Caddy; everything else 127.0.0.1.

nodes.label: Non-root container + pinned images
nodes.rationale: UID 10001; deliberate image upgrades.

nodes.label: Ley 1581 de 2012 - habeas data
nodes.rationale: Masked phones, no message texts in logs, rotation + retention.

nodes.label: Prometheus metrics (metabot_*)
nodes.rationale: Stable metric names are contracts for dashboards and alerts.

nodes.label: Readiness probe /ready
nodes.rationale: Queue, knowledge, LLM, circuit, Redis, WhatsApp config.

nodes.label: Alert rules
nodes.rationale: Down, backlog, queue full, circuit open, slow p95, fallback rate, Meta send errors.

nodes.label: Sizing rule workers x replicas <= OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL
nodes.rationale: More workers than LLM capacity only produces timeouts.

nodes.label: Load testing with mock Meta + LLM
nodes.rationale: Measure real capacity per hardware before production.

nodes.label: Single batched registry writer
nodes.rationale: No concurrent SQLite/gspread access; stays below Sheets write quota.

nodes.label: Google Sheets RAW writes
nodes.rationale: Prevents formula injection from customer text.

nodes.label: RAG anti-hallucination guardrails
nodes.rationale: Similarity threshold gate + grounding overlap + forbidden subjects.

nodes.label: Markdown conversation tree
nodes.rationale: Scripted flows before RAG; texts configurable.

nodes.label: Secrets scanning in CI (Gitleaks)
nodes.rationale: Least-privilege GITHUB_TOKEN with pull-requests: read.

nodes.label: One deployment per bot/process
nodes.rationale: Own .env, config profile, tree.md, knowledge_base and REDIS_PREFIX.

nodes.label: Leaked Ollama key remediation
nodes.rationale: Rotate key, purge history with git filter-repo, keep repo private.

nodes.label: Placeholder website/advisor number (pending)
nodes.rationale: Production start is blocked until real Fertrac URLs/numbers replace example.com / 15551234567.

nodes.label: Demo ACME knowledge base (pending)
nodes.rationale: Must be replaced by Fertrac documents before go-live.

nodes.label: uv.lock not generated (pending)
nodes.rationale: Reproducible builds need a committed lockfile.

hyperedges.label: Webhook ingest flow (signature, dedup, rate limit, enqueue)
